One of the highlights of our trip
May 2026 • Family
We had such an amazing experience thanks to Tan at the rooftop bar. He truly made our trip extra special. He was professional, attentive, incredibly kind, and went far above and beyond.

Tan gave us excellent menu recommendations and shared local places we should try while visiting. When we mentioned how sad we were that we hadn’t been able to find fresh green mangoes and our hotel didn’t have them on the menu, he actually helped us order them, communicated with the delivery driver for us, and made sure we got exactly what we were craving.

The rooftop bar itself is absolutely beautiful — the night swim with the glowing blue lights, the lights in the trees, and the stunning river views created the perfect atmosphere. But what truly elevated the experience was the exceptional hospitality.

His warmth, helpfulness, and genuine care turned a small moment into one of our favorite memories from this trip. Service like this is exactly why we returned again this year, and Tan is absolutely one of the reasons we would come back again. Thank you, Tan, for making our stay so memorable!
